title: Digital Tyre Inflator mounted on HPCL Pedestal - AIROJET 1000 LCV HP
description: HPCL canopy model pedestal mounted digital tyre inflator with 5 in 1 switch box.
subtitle: HPCL Pedestal - Normal
fullDescription: HPCL canopy model pedestal mounted digital tyre inflator. Features two digital readouts, LCD display with back light, 5 in 1 switch box with fuse protection and indicator, twin valve customized for tyre inflation process, and can be used for vehicle tyre ranging from two wheeler, car, SUV and mini truck.
features: Two digital readouts one for set pressure and other for tyre pressure
LCD display with back light to provide good visibility
Display remain at same set pressure value even at power on-off cycle
Audible and visual end of the cycle signal indicators
LED indication for the status of operation
Soft touch and durable membrane keys suitable for outdoor
Separate keys for set pressure increment and decrement
Flat key for empty or puncture tyre
25/35 key for easy front and back tyre pressure setting
Reset key to exit out of operation at any time
5 in 1 switch box with fuse protection and indicator
Twin valve customized for tyre inflation process
Can use for vehicle tyre ranging from two wheeler, car, SUV and mini truck

specifications.inputAirHose: 6mm x 2mtrs Black braider Hose with suitable fittings
specifications.inputFilter: 1/4 x 5 micron air filter with suitable fittings
specifications.outputAirHose: PVC braided hose suitable for 14Kg/cm2 pressure with round head foot connector
specifications.solenoid: Twin valve customized for tyre inflation process
specifications.keypad: Membrane Keypad suitable for outdoor application
specifications.display: 4 Digit 7 Segment LCD with Automatic LED backlight ON & OFF
specifications.dimensionsHPMini: 530 x 200 x 1400 mm (pedestal), 540 x 230 x 1440 mm (Packing)
specifications.dimensionsHPBig: 900 x 300 x 1750 mm (pedestal), 940 x 340 x 1770 mm (Packing)

applications: Specially for HP Fuel Station (HP CANOPY MODEL)
